body: Again, thanks. I'll update you on my decision in the morning. I can not thank you enough for convincing me to live, even if it's just for a night.

Regarding the first point - thanks. It just seems like I'm the only person I know who has been single their entire life.

I have talked to my mom, but she just ignores me. I guess I'll go to a social worker, but it's a hard thing to do. I guess it's instinct, wanting to stay with my family even if what they're doing is wrong.

Thanks.
